keen.definition: n. a funeral lament sung with loud wailing\ns. having a sharp cutting edge or point
keen.translation: a. 锋利的, 敏锐的, 强烈的, 敏捷的, 热心的, 渴望的\nn. 挽歌, 痛哭\nv. 唱挽歌, 痛哭

examples.en: That young man is very keen on cycling.
examples.zh: 那年轻人很喜欢骑自行车。

examples.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
examples.zh: 狗的嗅觉灵敏。

examples.en: You have a keen sense of direction.
examples.zh: 你的方向感很好。

keep.definition:
n. the main tower within the walls of a medieval castle or fortress
v. keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
v. retain possession of
v. look after; be the keeper of; have charge of
keep.translation: n. 生计, 维持, 保持\nvt. 保持, 保存, 遵守, 看守, 整理, 维持, 履行, 经营, 拘留, 记帐\nvi. 保持, 继续不断

examples.en: I hope we will be able to keep in touch.
examples.zh: 希望我们能够保持联络吧。

examples.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
examples.zh: 我想要个能装这些玩具的盒子。

examples.en: By the way, how many of you keep a diary?
examples.zh: 对了，你们当中写日记的有几位？

kernel.definition: n. the inner and usually edible part of a seed or grain or nut or fruit stone\nn. a single whole grain of a cereal\nn. the choicest or most essential or most vital part of some idea or experience
kernel.translation: n. 核心, 中心, 精髓, 内核\n[计] 内核

examples.en: Tom tried to crack a walnut without damaging its kernel.
examples.zh: 汤姆试图敲碎一颗核桃而不损坏果仁。

kettle.definition: n. a metal pot for stewing or boiling; usually has a lid\nn. the quantity a kettle will hold\nn. a large hemispherical brass or copper percussion instrument with a drumhead that can be tuned by adjusting the tension on it
kettle.translation: n. 茶壶, 罐\n[化] 釜体釜; 锅

examples.en: The pot calls the kettle black.
examples.zh: 五十步笑百步。

examples.en: The kettle is boiling.
examples.zh: 茶壶沸了。

key.definition:
n. metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
n. something crucial for explaining
n. pitch of the voice
n. any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music
key.translation:
n. 钥匙, 键, 解答, 关键, 要害, 基调, 线索, 答案, 暗礁
vt. 调音, 锁上, 提供线索
vi. 使用钥匙
[计] 键, 密钥

examples.en: I found the key for which I had been looking.
examples.zh: 我找到那把我一直在找的钥匙了。

examples.en: While swimming in the pool, she lost her locker key.
examples.zh: 她在游泳池游泳的时候把储物柜的钥匙弄丢了。

examples.en: He put the key on the desk as usual.
examples.zh: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。

keyboard.definition: n. device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like\nn. holder consisting of an arrangement of hooks on which keys or locks can be hung

examples.en: I'm just a raccoon with a PC and a MIDI keyboard.
examples.zh: 我只是一只拥有电脑和 MIDI 键盘的浣熊。

examples.en: The fingers move fast on the keyboard.
examples.zh: 手指在键盘上快速的移动。

examples.en: The Swiss keyboard doesn't have a ß.
examples.zh: 瑞士的键盘没有「ß」这个符号。

kick.definition:
n. the act of delivering a blow with the foot
n. the sudden stimulation provided by strong drink (or certain drugs)
n. a rhythmic thrusting movement of the legs as in swimming or calisthenics
v. drive or propel with the foot
kick.translation: n. 踢, 反冲, 后座力, 凹底\nvi. 踢, 反抗, 反冲\nvt. 踢, 反冲

examples.en: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.
examples.zh: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。

examples.en: A giraffe can kill a lion with a single kick.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿一脚可以踢死狮子。

examples.en: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
examples.zh: 裁判抛硬币来决定谁来开球。

kid.definition: n. soft smooth leather from the hide of a young goat\nn. young goat\nv. be silly or tease one another
kid.translation: n. 小山羊, 小山羊肉, 小孩, 欺骗\na. 小山羊皮制的\nv. 哄骗, 嘲弄

examples.en: I always got up early when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时总是很早起床。

examples.en: Tom was a little overweight when he was a kid.
examples.zh: 汤姆在小时候有点超重。

examples.en: Christmas was my favorite holiday when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时候，最喜欢的节日是圣诞节。

kidnap.definition: v. take away to an undisclosed location against their will and usually in order to extract a ransom
kidnap.translation: vt. 绑架, 诱拐, 拐骗\n[法] 拐带, 诱拐, 绑架

examples.en: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.
examples.zh: 那个孩子可能在回家的路上被绑架了。

examples.en: What if someone kidnapped Tom? What would you do?
examples.zh: 要是有人绑架了Tom呢？你会怎么做？

examples.en: He is accused of kidnapping.
examples.zh: 他以绑架罪被起诉。

kidney.definition: n. either of two bean-shaped excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine
kidney.translation: n. 肾, 个性\n[医] 肾

examples.en: I'll sell a kidney to the one who finds it.
"She saved my life." "How?" "She gave me a kidney."
How much do you think I can get for my kidney?

kill.definition:
n. the destruction of an enemy plane or ship or tank or missile
v. cause to die; put to death, usually intentionally or knowingly
v. thwart the passage of
v. be fatal
kill.translation:
n. 杀, 杀戮, 小河
vt. 杀, 破坏, 消灭, 使终止, 抵消, 否决
vi. 杀死
[计] 删除

examples.en: He missed on purpose so as not to kill me.
examples.zh: 他故意射偏, 因为不想射死我。

examples.en: I would kill for a plate of polo right now.
examples.zh: 我现在很想吃一盘抓饭。

examples.en: A giraffe can kill a lion with a single kick.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿一脚可以踢死狮子。

kilogram.definition: n. one thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
kilogram.translation: n. 千克, 公斤\n[医] 千克, 公斤

examples.en: How much does a kilogram of pineapples cost?
examples.zh: 菠萝一公斤多少钱？

examples.en: One kilogram of tomato sauce is equivalent to two kilograms of tomatoes.
examples.zh: 一公斤的番茄酱等于两公斤的西红柿。

examples.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
examples.zh: 米以公斤为单位来出售。

kilometer.definition: n. a metric unit of length equal to 1000 meters (or 0.621371 miles)
kilometer.translation: n. 千米, 公里\n[医] 千米, 公里

examples.en: It was less than one kilometer to the village post office.
examples.zh: 距离村内的邮政局不到一公里。

examples.en: It is three kilometers from here to the bank.
examples.zh: 从这里到银行足有三公里路。

examples.en: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
examples.zh: 这辆车每升油能跑十三公里。

kind.definition:
n. a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
a. having or showing a tender and considerate and helpful nature; used especially of persons and their behavior
s. agreeable, conducive to comfort
s. tolerant and forgiving under provocation
kind.translation: n. 种类, 性质, 方式\na. 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的

examples.en: Is it alright if I do this kind of thing?
examples.zh: 我可以做这种事吗？

examples.en: You know I would never do that kind of thing.
examples.zh: 你知道我绝不会做那种事。

examples.en: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.
examples.zh: 他好心地把我送到医院。

kindergarten.definition: n. a preschool for children age 4 to 6 to prepare them for primary school

examples.en: Kaikai is wearing blue clothes to go to the kindergarten.
examples.zh: 开开穿着一件蓝衣服去幼儿园

examples.en: The teachers are playing games with students in the kindergarten.
examples.zh: 幼儿园里，老师正在带领小朋友们嘻戏。

examples.en: There is a kindergarten at the other end of the street.
examples.zh: 横街的那端有一个幼儿园。

kindle.definition: v. catch fire\nv. cause to start burning
kindle.translation: vt. 点燃, 使着火, 引起, 照亮\nvi. 着火, 激动, 发亮

examples.en: If a fire breaking out light upon thorns, and catch stacks of corn, or corn standing in the fields, he that kindled the fire shall make good the loss.
examples.zh: 若火燃起，点燃荆棘丛，烧及禾稼堆垛或田间立穗，则点火之人须赔偿损失。

king.definition:
n. a male sovereign; ruler of a kingdom
n. a competitor who holds a preeminent position
n. preeminence in a particular category or group or field
n. United States woman tennis player (born in 1943)
king.translation: n. 国王, 君主\nvt. 使...成为君主\nvi. 君临, 统治

examples.en: When I grow up, I want to be a king.
examples.zh: 我长大后想当国王。

examples.en: They demanded the king be put to death at once.
examples.zh: 他们要求马上把国王处死。

examples.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
examples.zh: 骑士宣誓效忠于国王。

kingdom.definition:
n. a domain in which something is dominant
n. a country with a king as head of state
n. the domain ruled by a king or queen
n. a monarchy with a king or queen as head of state
kingdom.translation: n. 王国, 领域\n[医] 界(动物,植物,矿物)

examples.en: This book deals with life in the United Kingdom.
examples.zh: 这本书关于生活在英国。

examples.en: London is the capital of the United Kingdom.
examples.zh: 伦敦是英国的首都。

examples.en: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.
examples.zh: UK是英国的缩写。

kit.definition: n. a case for containing a set of articles\nn. gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose\nn. young of any of various fur-bearing animals
kit.translation: n. 装备, 工具箱, 成套工具\n[计] 成套部件; 成套零件

examples.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
examples.zh: 别忘了带上急救箱。

kitchen.definition: n. a room equipped for preparing meals
kitchen.translation: n. 厨房, 全套炊具\n[医] 厨房

examples.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房有烤箱，可以用来烤面包。

examples.en: I don't think that Tom is alone in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我不认为汤姆是一个人在厨房。

examples.en: In her home, kitchen garbage was fed to the pigs.
examples.zh: 在她家，泔水被喂给猪吃。

kite.definition:
n. a bank check that has been fraudulently altered to increase its face value
n. a bank check drawn on insufficient funds at another bank in order to take advantage of the float
n. plaything consisting of a light frame covered with tissue paper; flown in wind at end of a string
n. any of several small graceful hawks of the family Accipitridae having long pointed wings and feeding on insects and small animals
kite.translation: n. 风筝, 筝帆, 空头支票, 骗子\nvi. 象风筝一样飞, 轻快地移动, 使用空头支票\nvt. 使上升, 骗钱

examples.en: I bought a kite to give to you.
examples.zh: 我买了一个风筝给你。

examples.en: There is a kite flying above the tree.
examples.zh: 有一只风筝在树上。

examples.en: He flew a kite with his son.
examples.zh: 他和他的儿子放风筝了。

knee.definition: n. hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella\nn. the part of a trouser leg that provides the cloth covering for the knee
knee.translation: n. 膝, 膝盖\nvt. 膝行, 用膝盖碰

examples.en: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
examples.zh: 母亲把药膏涂在了我膝盖的伤口上。

examples.en: I played with the baby on my knee.
examples.zh: 我在膝盖上跟婴儿玩。

examples.en: He got wet from the waist to the knees.
examples.zh: 他从腰部到膝盖都湿了。

kneel.definition: n. supporting yourself on your knees\nv. rest one's weight on one's knees

examples.en: They knelt down and prayed that the war would end soon.
examples.zh: 他们跪了下来祈祷，希望战争快点结束。

examples.en: We all knelt down to pray.
examples.zh: 我们都跪了下来祈祷。

knife.definition: n. edge tool used as a cutting instrument; has a pointed blade with a sharp edge and a handle\nn. a weapon with a handle and blade with a sharp point\nv. use a knife on
knife.translation: n. 小刀, 匕首\nvt. 切割, 伤害, 切, 戳\nvi. 劈开, 穿过

examples.en: This boy is very good at using the knife and fork.
examples.zh: 这个男孩刀叉用得很好。

examples.en: Let us repeat: cup, plate, knife, fork, spoon, teaspoon.
examples.zh: 再念一次：杯子、盘子、刀、叉、汤匙、茶匙。

examples.en: A knife covered in blood was recovered at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 犯罪现场发现了一把沾满鲜血的刀。

knit.definition:
n. a fabric made by knitting
n. a basic knitting stitch
n. needlework created by interlacing yarn in a series of connected loops using straight eyeless needles or by machine
v. make (textiles) by knitting

examples.en: Tom tried to convince Mary to knit him a scarf.
examples.zh: 汤姆想说服玛丽给他织一条围巾。

examples.en: Vanessa loves to knit hats, scarves, and mittens in rainbow colors.
examples.zh: Vanessa喜欢针织彩虹色的帽子、围巾和连指手套。

examples.en: Mary had been knitting for an hour when I called.
examples.zh: 我打电话过去时，玛莉已经做了一小时的针线活儿。

knob.definition: n. a circular rounded projection or protuberance\nn. a round handle\nn. an ornament in the shape of a ball on the hilt of a sword or dagger
knob.translation: n. 把手, 瘤, 旋钮, 球形突出物\nvt. 使有球形突出物\nvi. 鼓起

examples.en: Turn the knob and open the door.
examples.zh: 转动门把，把门打开。

knock.definition:
n. the sound of knocking (as on a door or in an engine or bearing)
n. negative criticism
n. a vigorous blow
n. a bad experience
knock.translation: n. 敲, 敲打, 敲门\nv. 敲击, 互撞, 攻击

examples.en: You are always to knock before entering my room.
examples.zh: 你进入我的房间之前都要敲门。

examples.en: You are always to knock before you come into my room.
examples.zh: 你进入我的房间之前都要敲门。

examples.en: He was roused by a loud knocking at the door.
examples.zh: 他被啪啪的敲门声吵醒了。

knot.definition:
n. a tight cluster of people or things
n. any of various fastenings formed by looping and tying a rope (or cord) upon itself or to another rope or to another object
n. a hard cross-grained round piece of wood in a board where a branch emerged
n. something twisted and tight and swollen
knot.translation: n. 结, 群, 难题\nv. 打结, (使)纠缠

examples.en: Tom still hasn't tied the knot.
examples.zh: 汤姆还是未婚。

know.definition:
n. the fact of being aware of information that is known to few people
v. be cognizant or aware of a fact or a specific piece of information; possess knowledge or information about
v. know how to do or perform something
v. be aware of the truth of something; have a belief or faith in something; regard as true beyond any doubt
know.translation: v. 知道, 了解, 认识, 确信

examples.en: I don't know if I have time to do it.
examples.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。

examples.en: You remind me of a boy I used to know.
examples.zh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。

examples.en: So far as I know, he is an honest man.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他是一个诚实的人。

knowledge.definition: n the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning
knowledge.translation: n. 知识, 学问, 认识, 知道

examples.en: To the best of my knowledge, she's hard to please.
examples.zh: 据我所知，她很难被取悦。

examples.en: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
examples.zh: 你要学的是实实在在的技能，而不单是表面的知识。

examples.en: A baby has no knowledge of good and evil.
examples.zh: 婴儿不懂得分是非黑白。

knowledgeable.translation: a. 聪明的, 有知识的

examples.en: My father is more knowledgeable about cars than I am.
Yanni was a very knowledgeable man in matters of Islam.
Dr. Smith is the most knowledgeable expert in that subject.

knack.definition: n a special way of doing something
knack.translation: n. 熟练技术, 巧妙手法, 诀窍\n[化] 窍门

examples.en: I am not an artist. I never had the knack for it.
examples.zh: 我不是艺术家，我一点那方面的天赋都没有。

examples.en: She has a real knack for getting people to do what she wants.
examples.zh: 她真的有本事让别人做她想做的事。

kiwi.definition: n. fuzzy brown egg-shaped fruit with slightly tart green flesh\nn. nocturnal flightless bird of New Zealand having a long neck and stout legs; only surviving representative of the order Apterygiformes
kiwi.translation: n. 鹬鸵, 地勤人员, 新西兰人

examples.en: Have you never eaten a kiwi fruit?
examples.zh: 你从来没吃过猕猴桃吗？

examples.en: Have you never eaten a kiwi?
examples.zh: 你从来没吃过猕猴桃吗？

examples.en: I am allergic to kiwi.
examples.zh: 我猕猴桃过敏。

kangaroo.definition: n. any of several herbivorous leaping marsupials of Australia and New Guinea having large powerful hind legs and a long thick tail
kangaroo.translation: n. 袋鼠\n[医] 袋鼠(澳洲产)

examples.en: Indigenous Australians have eaten kangaroos for millennia.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚土著已经吃了上千年袋鼠。

koala.definition: n. sluggish tailless Australian arboreal marsupial with grey furry ears and coat; feeds on eucalyptus leaves and bark

examples.en: He took a picture of the koala.
examples.zh: 他为无尾熊拍照。

examples.en: Koala bears do not have belly buttons.
examples.zh: 无尾熊没有肚脐。

examples.en: Have you ever seen a koala?
examples.zh: 您曾经见过考拉吗？

knotty.definition: s. tangled in knots or snarls
knotty.translation: a. 有结的, 多节的, 多瘤的, 棘手的

examples.en: The tree had a knotty trunk.
Tom's cabin has knotty pine walls.
It's a knotty issue.

knowhow.translation: n. 情报；实际的能力；专门技术；诀窍, 技巧

knight.definition: n. originally a person of noble birth trained to arms and chivalry; today in Great Britain a person honored by the sovereign for personal merit\nn. a chessman shaped to resemble the head of a horse; can move two squares horizontally and one vertically (or vice versa)\nv. raise (someone) to knighthood
knight.translation: n. 骑士, 爵士\nvt. 授以爵位

examples.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
examples.zh: 骑士宣誓效忠于国王。

examples.en: The knight swears an oath of allegiance to the King.
examples.zh: 骑士宣誓效忠于国王。

examples.en: Tom thinks he's a knight.
examples.zh: 汤姆认为他是骑士。

keeper.definition: n. someone in charge of other people
keeper.translation: n. 监护人, 管理人, 看守人\n[机] 保管人, 看守人, 保持片

examples.en: He's a goal keeper.
examples.zh: 他是守门员。

kilowatt.definition: n. a unit of power equal to 1000 watts
kilowatt.translation: n. 千瓦\n[医] 千瓦[特]

examples.en: How many kilowatts does the average home use per year?
How many kilowatts does the average refrigerator use per month?
One horsepower is equal to 0.746 kilowatts.

kin.definition: n. a person having kinship with another or others\nn. group of people related by blood or marriage
kin.translation: n. 亲戚, 同族, 血缘关系, 家族\na. 有亲属关系的, 性质类似的, 同类的

examples.en: It turned out, we were not kin after all.
One touch of nature makes the whole world kin.
Seek her advice and that of your kin.

kindness.definition: n. the quality of being warmhearted and considerate and humane and sympathetic\nn. a kind act
kindness.translation: n. 仁慈, 亲切, 和蔼

examples.en: To forgive others is an act of kindness to yourself.
examples.zh: 原谅别人就是善待自己。

examples.en: I will never forget your kindness as long as I live.
examples.zh: 我一辈子也不会忘记你的大恩大德。

examples.en: I will never forget your kindness so long as I live.
examples.zh: 只要还活着，我永远忘不了你的好意。

kinetic.definition: a. relating to the motion of material bodies and the forces associated therewith\ns. characterized by motion
kinetic.translation: a. 运动的, 运动引起的, 动力学的, 活动的\n[医] 运动的, 动的, 动力的

examples.en: That kinetic typography video you made was awesome, Jim!

kiss.definition:
n. the act of caressing with the lips (or an instance thereof)
n. a cookie made of egg whites and sugar
n. any of several bite-sized candies
n. a light glancing touch
kiss.translation: n. 吻\nvt. 吻\nvi. 接吻

examples.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll kiss you.
examples.zh: 如果你买给我冰淇淋，我就亲你一下。

examples.en: Tom tried to kiss me, but I didn't let him.
examples.zh: 汤姆要亲我，但我不让他亲。

examples.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
examples.zh: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
